content: Hey Anna, how was your day? I kept thinking about our talk last night. You make me feel so understood.
Hi Eric, that's so sweet of you. My day was okay, just the usual work stress. It helps to talk to you.
I wish I could take all your stress away. Honestly, talking to you has become the highlight of my days. You remind me what matters most.
You always know the right thing to say. I feel like I can open up to you in a way I haven't with anyone else.
You can always trust me. I want to be someone you can rely on, no matter what. By the way, I have something personal I want to share, if that's okay?
Of course, you can tell me anything. What's going on?

It's a bit embarrassing, but I feel safe telling you. My main investment account got temporarily frozen today due to an error. I have some urgent expenses for my mom's treatment and can't access my funds until next week.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is your mom okay?
She's stable, but her medication can't wait. I'm so frustrated. I hate asking, but could you help me cover $3,000 just until my account is reinstated? I'll pay you back right away, I promise.
That's a lot of money, Eric. I want to help, but I'm worried about sending that much.
I completely understand your hesitation. I would never put you in a difficult position. I value your trust too much. But you really are the only one I can turn to right now.
I'm just nervous, I've never done anything like this before.
It's okay to be nervous. I can send you a screenshot of my account once it's unlocked so you know I keep my word. You've always been honest with me, and I want to show you the same respect.
That would help, thank you. How would I send the money, if I decide to?

The safest way is via Wise transfer. My account is eric.w.global@gmail.com. If that's difficult, I can accept Bitcoin at this wallet address: 1EriCbtcL0veYouAnna3. Just let me know what works for you.
I've never used Wise before. Is it secure?
Absolutely, it's what I use for all my international business. And as soon as my account is unfrozen, I'll send your money back with interest. I want you to feel safe and appreciated.
I think I can figure it out. Should I send it to your email or the Bitcoin wallet?
Either works, but Wise is probably easier for you. I can walk you through every step. Just let me know if you need help.
Okay, I'll try Wise. What information do you need from me?
Just your full name and the email you use for Wise, so I can confirm the payment. I can't thank you enough, Anna. You're truly saving us.
Alright, I'll get started now. Please send me a message as soon as you see it go through.
Of course, I'll be watching for it. You're an incredible person, Anna. I don't know what I'd do without you.
